subject.title: fix(acp): scope Discord thread session keys

question: Should this bug fix intentionally split existing parent-scoped Discord configured ACP sessions into fresh per-thread sessions without migrating the old shared ACP state?
rationale: The code fix matches the isolation bug, but the generated persistent session key changes are upgrade-visible and ClawSweeper cannot choose the migration policy for maintainers.

options.title: Accept Fresh Per-Thread State
options.body: Treat the old parent-scoped state as contaminated, require the branch refresh and proof, and allow existing threads to start fresh isolated ACP sessions.

options.title: Require A Migration Policy
options.body: Pause merge until the PR preserves, migrates, or explicitly retires old parent-scoped ACP state with maintainer-approved behavior and tests.

options.title: Replace The Branch
options.body: Close or replace this branch if maintainers want the keying fix folded into a broader ACP session-state repair instead of this focused PR.

recommendation.title: Accept Fresh Per-Thread State
recommendation.body: Treat the old parent-scoped state as contaminated, require the branch refresh and proof, and allow existing threads to start fresh isolated ACP sessions.
